Accept known differences

Source: R/accept.R
accept_differences.Rd

Once a difference has been read and found intended (a fixed bug, a new default that NEWS announces), it can be accepted, so that later comparisons, the pull-request summary and check_differences() report only differences nobody has looked at yet. accept_differences() appends rows of differences() to a CSV file of rules; pass that file to compare_runs() (or run_dossier()) as accept.

Usage

accept_differences(x, path, reason = NA_character_)

Arguments

x

A data frame of differences to accept, from differences().

path

The CSV file of rules; created if needed, appended to otherwise.

reason

Why these differences are accepted, kept with the rules.

Value

path, invisibly.

Details

A rule has the columns kind, scenario, step, path, cand and reason. A difference is accepted when it matches every one of the first five; an empty field or * matches anything, and * and ? work as wildcards inside a field (step = "fit_*"). The candidate's side (cand) is part of the rule, so a number accepted at its new value shows up again if it moves further; set it to * to accept any value.

Examples

# \donttest{
d <- example_dossier()
prepare_versions(d, quiet = TRUE)
run_scenarios(d, quiet = TRUE)
cmp <- compare_runs(d)
rules <- file.path(tempdir(), "accepted.csv")
accept_differences(differences(cmp, kind = "plot_changed"), rules,
                   reason = "points are red now, as NEWS says")
cmp <- compare_runs(d, accept = rules)
differences(cmp, accepted = TRUE)
#>   scenario step label         kind severity path       base       cand
#> 1    intro draw  draw plot_changed        3 plot 1 image(s) 1 image(s)
#>   rel_change                 detail news no_news accepted
#> 1         NA 0.22% of pixels differ <NA>    TRUE     TRUE
#>                    accepted_reason
#> 1 points are red now, as NEWS says
# }
